title: Targeted stimulation of motor cortex ensembles drives learned movements
title_zh: 有针对性的运动皮层群体刺激驱动学习运动
abstract: During the execution of learned motor skills, the neural population in layer 2/3 (L2/3) of primary motor cortex (M1) expresses a reproducible spatiotemporal activity pattern1. It is debated whether M1 actively participates in generating this learned pattern and whether this pattern causally drives the learned movement2–5. Here we combined in vivo two-photon calcium imaging and holographic optogenetic stimulation of functionally defined M1 L2/3 ensembles in mice performing a skilled lever-pressing task. Brief synchronous stimulation of about 20 neurons whose activity onset precedes voluntary movement onset induced movements resembling the learned movement, while producing activity patterns in other M1 neurons resembling the learned activity. Moreover, trial-by-trial variability of optogenetically triggered population activity correlated with variability in the induced movements. These variabilities were predicted by the initial state of M1 activity preceding stimulation. In some trials, stimulation induced the learned activity without inducing movements, indicating that the learned activity is not simply a reflection of movements but can arise internally. Stimulation failed to generate movements or learned activity in task-disengaged mice. Stimulation of neurons whose activity followed movement onsets failed to induce the learned movement in task-engaged mice. Together, the learned activity in M1 L2/3 can be generated when M1 is prepared at the optimal initial state and receives precise triggering inputs, supporting the active role of M1 in generating learned activity and learned movements. Optogenetic stimulation of motor-cortex neuron ensembles shows that precisely timed activity in the primary motor cortex can generate learned neural patterns and movements, demonstrating an active role in skilled motor control.
abstract_zh: 在学习运动技能执行过程中，初级运动皮层（M1）第2/3层（L2/3）的神经群体表现出可重复的时空活动模式1。人们存在争论M1是否积极参与生成这种学习模式，以及这种模式是否因果驱动学习运动2–5。本研究结合小鼠执行熟练杠杆按压任务时的体内两光子钙成像和全息光遗传学刺激，对功能定义的M1 L2/3群体进行刺激。对约20个其活动起始先于自主运动起始的神经进行简短同步刺激，诱发类似学习运动的运动，同时在其他M1神经中产生类似学习活动的活动模式。此外，optogenetically触发的群体活动的试间变异与诱发运动的变异相关联。这些变异由刺激前M1活动的初始状态预测。在某些试验中，刺激在不诱发运动的情况下诱发学习活动，表明学习活动并非仅仅是运动的反映，而是可以内部产生的。在任务脱离的小鼠中，刺激未能诱发运动或学习活动。刺激那些活动随运动起始而激活的神经，在任务投入的小鼠中未能诱发学习运动。总之，M1 L2/3中的学习活动在M1处于最佳初始状态并接收精确触发输入时可以产生，支持M1在生成学习活动和学习运动中起主动作用。对运动皮层神经群体的光遗传学刺激表明，初级运动皮层中精确定时的活动可以生成学习神经模式和运动，展示了其在精细运动控制中的主动作用。
